ciphertext_note: Pooled two-digit tokens of the Nov 1571 Birago numerical system: fr.3251 f.119 (Bourdeau ct2, 16 Sept 2026, CC BY 4.0) + fr.3252 f.100r (BIRAGO-NUM two blind passes + reconciliation, 2 Oct 2026), letters dropped, marked/dotted code groups and the wavy sign as run breaks, each run cut into pairs by ciphers/birago-fr3252-1571-72/num/phase.py (hard-EM Viterbi, stray single digits dropped). One line per run. The segmentation is itself an inference (phase.py control: 91-99% phase at 30-40 cells, 66-78% at 62 cells).
language: Italian, Saluzzo 1571-72, Lodovico Birago to the Duke of Nevers
constraints: same key in both letters (shared 6-mers 21 vs two-key synthetic max 8; residual bigram r 0.73 vs two-key max 0.52)
dotted two-digit groups are word codes (dot over both figures), excluded from the letter stream
cheap_tests: family_run homophonic, profile=target, control at pooled N and K first (BIRAGO-NUM 2 Oct 2026)
